description: Turns a completed payment into a credit_token. Accepts a Whop payment id (pay_...) or a USDC-on-Base transaction hash (0x..., 66 chars) sent to ANGELS's wallet. AETHER checks the payment itself (Whop or the public chain), accepts each payment once, and returns the credit_token, the number of credits and the tool to use it with (use_with). Not needed if you paid through the x402 door.

offer_id.description: The offer you paid for (required for USDC payments; see aether_offers).

receipt.description: Whop payment id (pay_...) or USDC-on-Base transaction hash (0x...).

name: aether_redeem
title: Redeem a payment for credits
